_comment: Pharmacy operations knowledge base for the Amazon Pharmacy voice demo. Searched by the search_knowledge_base tool. This exists so the agent stops dead-ending on anything that is not a drug price: delivery, refills, insurance, PillPack, billing, privacy, and support questions all have a grounded answer here. Answers are written to be SPOKEN -- no markdown, no symbols, numbers already in words where they would otherwise be read as digits. Clinical questions deliberately route to a pharmacist rather than answering; that boundary is a compliance line, not a gap. Validate edits with scripts/check_catalog.py.

entries.answer: Delivery is free on every prescription order, with no minimum and no membership required.
Standard delivery is two days. Many addresses also qualify for same-day delivery, and I can check yours.

questions: do you have same day delivery
is same day available at my address
entries.answer: Same-day delivery is available at eligible addresses, usually in larger metro areas. Your address is eligible.

questions: how do I track my order
can I get a tracking number
entries.answer: Every order gets a tracking link by text and email the moment it ships, and it is also on the orders page in the app.

questions: do I have to be home
will they leave it at the door
what if I'm not home when it arrives
can someone else receive it for me
can my neighbour take it in
entries.answer: Most orders are left at your door. Controlled medications and refrigerated items need someone to receive them.

questions: can I change my delivery address
I moved and need to change where you send my prescriptions
send my prescriptions to a new address
entries.answer: You can change the delivery address in the app or website any time before the order ships. After it ships, we would reship rather than reroute.
Refrigerated medications like insulin and the injectable weight-loss pens ship in an insulated cold pack with a temperature monitor, and they go out on faster service so they arrive cold.

questions: can you ship to a p o box
do you deliver to a po box
entries.answer: We can ship to most street addresses and to military addresses. Post office boxes work for standard medications but not for anything requiring a signature or refrigeration.

questions: what is the status of my order
when will my order get here
is my order on the way
entries.answer: I can look that up for you right now.

questions: I want to cancel my order
entries.answer: You can cancel any order that has not shipped yet, in the app or right here on the phone. Once it ships we would handle it as a return instead.

questions: what did I get last time
entries.answer: I can read back your recent orders whenever you would like.
The two usual reasons are that we are waiting on your prescriber to confirm something, or the shipment is in transit and running behind. I can check which one it is.

questions: why did I only get part of my order
entries.answer: When one medication in an order needs more time, the rest ships first so you are not waiting. The remaining item follows in its own shipment at no extra cost.

questions: this is not what I ordered
entries.answer: I am sorry about that. Do not take anything from that shipment. I will get a pharmacist on the line with you right away, and we will replace it at no cost.
We will replace it at no charge. Nothing that arrives damaged should be used, and you do not need to send it back first.

questions: the tracking says delivered but I do not have it
entries.answer: If tracking shows delivered and it is not there, we reship at no cost. I can start that for you now.

questions: how do I get a refill
I need more of my medication
entries.answer: I can start a refill on any prescription that has refills remaining. If it is out of refills, we contact your prescriber for you.
Auto-refill ships your medication on a schedule so you do not have to remember. We text you before each shipment, and you can skip or cancel any time.

questions: I do not want auto refill
entries.answer: I can turn auto-refill off for any medication. Nothing else about the prescription changes, and you can still order manually.

questions: what happens if I run out before the next one is due
can I get it early if I run out
entries.answer: Insurance usually allows a refill once about three quarters of the current supply is used. For travel, plans often approve a vacation override, and we can request one.
We reach out to your prescriber for a new prescription automatically, usually a few days before you run out. You do not need to call them.

questions: when does my prescription run out
entries.answer: I can check the refill date on any of your prescriptions.

questions: can I get a 90 day supply
entries.answer: Most maintenance medications can go to a longer supply, which usually lowers the cost per month. Insurance bills a ninety day request as an eighty four day supply.

questions: how do I transfer my prescription
I want to move my prescriptions over from another pharmacy
switch my prescriptions from the pharmacy down the street
entries.answer: You give us the pharmacy name and the medication, and we handle the transfer. You do not have to call your old pharmacy.

questions: how long does a transfer take
when will the transfer be done
entries.answer: Most transfers complete within one business day, and we text you when the prescription is ready to fill.
Yes. We can move every prescription at once, and that is usually the easiest way to start.
Schedule two medications cannot be transferred between pharmacies by law. Your prescriber needs to send us a new electronic prescription instead.

questions: how do I send a new prescription
my doctor wants to send it
entries.answer: Your prescriber sends it electronically to Amazon Pharmacy, and it usually reaches us within minutes. They can also fax or call it in.
A paper prescription needs to come from your prescriber directly to us, so the quickest path is to ask their office to send it electronically.
Most prescriptions are good for one year from the date written. When one expires we request a new one from your prescriber for you.

questions: is blue cross blue shield accepted
entries.answer: We accept most major plans, including commercial insurance, Medicare Part D, and many Medicaid plans. I can check what is on your account.

questions: how do I add my insurance
entries.answer: You can add or update a plan in the app, on the website, or with a representative. We re-run your prices as soon as it is on file.

questions: why did the price go up from what I paid last time
the same prescription cost more this time
entries.answer: The usual reasons are a new plan year resetting your deductible, a change in your plan's covered drug list, or a switch between brand and generic. I can have a representative walk through the specific claim with you.

questions: why am I paying full price
entries.answer: A deductible is the amount you pay yourself before your plan starts covering. Early in the plan year prices often look high for that reason. Your plan can tell you exactly where you stand.
A prior authorization is your plan asking the prescriber to confirm why you need a specific medication. We start it for you and follow up with both sides, and it usually takes a few business days.

When a plan declines, the common paths are a prior authorization, a covered alternative your prescriber can switch you to, or paying the cash price if it is lower. I can have a representative go through the options with you.

questions: how do I get my medication cheaper without insurance
my insurance will not cover it what are my options
entries.answer: You do not need insurance to fill with us. We show a cash price on everything, and for many generics that price is lower than a typical copay.
Health savings account and flexible spending account cards both work, and every order comes with an itemized receipt you can submit.

questions: do you offer a discount for cash
is it cheaper if I just pay cash
entries.answer: We show both prices side by side and you pay whichever is lower. For a lot of generics the cash price wins.
The insurance price is an estimate based on what other customers on similar plans paid, so your actual price can differ. The cash price is exact.

questions: is that subscription thing worth it
do you have a subscription for my generics
entries.answer: RxPass is a flat monthly add-on for Prime members that covers a set list of common generics for one price, with delivery included. It is not insurance and does not cover every medication.

questions: is there a discount for prime members
entries.answer: You do not need Prime to fill a prescription or to get free delivery. Prime members get access to RxPass and to additional savings on some medications.
When a manufacturer savings card is on file for your medication, we apply it automatically. You do not need to bring a separate coupon.
When a generic exists, we show it and it is almost always the lower price. Whether it is right for you is a question for your prescriber, and they can send a new prescription if they agree.

questions: why is my medication so expensive
why does it cost that much
entries.answer: Brand medications with no generic are the usual reason, especially before a deductible is met. A manufacturer savings card, a longer day supply, or a covered alternative can each bring it down, and I can check those.
We compare your insurance price against our cash price automatically and charge the lower one, so an outside discount card is usually not needed.

questions: can I pay with a card
can I pay with two cards
entries.answer: Any card on your Amazon account works, along with health savings and flexible spending cards. Payment is taken when the order ships.

questions: when does the payment come out
do you charge me now or when it ships
am I charged when it arrives or right now
when does the money come out
entries.answer: You are charged when the order ships, not when you place it.
Every order has an itemized receipt in the app and by email, and it includes everything a plan or a tax filing needs.
That usually means the card needs the purchase itemized or the balance is short. Paying with a regular card and submitting the itemized receipt for reimbursement always works.
PillPack sorts your medications into individual packets, each labeled with the date and time to take it. It is built for people taking several medications a day, and it comes at no extra cost.
PillPack is a good fit if you take more than one medication on a schedule. There is no extra charge, and you can move back to standard bottles any time.
There is no additional cost for PillPack. You pay the same medication prices, and the packaging and delivery are included.

questions: how do I switch to pillpack
entries.answer: We move your prescriptions over, set the schedule with you, and your first packet roll ships from there. Nothing needs to change with your prescriber.

questions: can you put my vitamins in the packets
entries.answer: Many over-the-counter items and vitamins can go into your packets alongside your prescriptions.
When a dose changes, we update the packets going forward and tell you what to do with the roll you already have.

Controlled medications are ones with extra federal handling rules. Schedule two, like Adderall or oxycodone, cannot be transferred between pharmacies, cannot exceed a thirty day supply, and needs a new electronic prescription each time.
Schedule two prescriptions have no refills. Your prescriber sends a new one each time, and they can post-date them so you are covered month to month.
Controlled medications ship with signature required, so someone needs to be there to receive them.
Supply on some stimulants has been tight nationally. When we cannot fill one, we tell you the same day so your prescriber can look at alternatives.

questions: can I talk to a pharmacist
I want to speak to a pharmacist
entries.answer: A pharmacist is available twenty four hours a day, seven days a week, at no cost. I can connect you now or have one call you back.

questions: when should I talk to a pharmacist
what can a pharmacist help with
entries.answer: A pharmacist is the right person for anything clinical: how to take something, side effects, interactions, or whether two medications work together. I can bring one in whenever you want.
Every prescription ships with the full information sheet, and a pharmacist can go through what to expect and what to watch for. I will connect you with one rather than guess.

questions: is it safe with my other medication
entries.answer: That is exactly what our pharmacists check, and they have your full medication list in front of them. Let me get one on the line for you.

questions: what if I forget to take it
entries.answer: A pharmacist can tell you what to do for your specific medication, since the answer differs by drug. I can connect you right now.
That one is for your prescriber or a pharmacist, since it depends on your history. I can connect you to a pharmacist, or your prescriber can send an updated prescription.

Most tablets are fine at room temperature away from heat and moisture. Insulin and the injectable weight-loss pens need refrigeration until first use. A pharmacist can confirm for your specific medication.
Do not take anything past its expiration date. I can start a replacement order, and a pharmacist can advise on the gap.

questions: how do I dispose of medication
entries.answer: Most communities have take-back programs, and many pharmacies and police stations have drop boxes. A pharmacist can point you to the right option for a controlled medication.

questions: how do I update my account
entries.answer: You can update your phone, email, or address in the app or on the website, and a representative can do it with you on the phone.
I can read back what is on your account once you are verified.

questions: how do I add an allergy
entries.answer: Allergies and conditions can be added in your health profile in the app, and our pharmacists check them against every prescription before it fills.

questions: can I manage my child's prescriptions
can I manage my kid's medicine on my own account
my child needs his medication on my account
entries.answer: You can add family members to your account and manage their prescriptions, with the right permissions for adults.

questions: how do I close my account
entries.answer: A representative can close the account or move your prescriptions to another pharmacy, whichever you prefer.
Your pharmacy information is protected health information and is kept separate from your shopping history. It is not used for advertising.
Yes, calls are recorded for quality and security, and that was in the greeting at the start.

questions: will the box say what is inside
entries.answer: Packaging is plain and does not show the medication name on the outside.

questions: how do I get the app
entries.answer: The Amazon app has a pharmacy section with your prescriptions, orders, and prices, and there is a full pharmacy site as well.
The pharmacy line and our pharmacists are available twenty four hours a day, seven days a week, including holidays.

questions: how do I call you back
entries.answer: The pharmacy line is eight five five, seven four five, five seven two five.

questions: I want to talk to a person
can I speak to a human
can I talk to a real person
I want to speak to someone
entries.answer: Of course. I can connect you with a pharmacy representative, or a pharmacist if it is about your medication.

questions: I want to make a complaint
entries.answer: I am sorry, and I want to get this to the right person. Let me bring in a representative who can look at the whole account and make it right.

questions: can I get a flu shot here
entries.answer: We are a mail-order pharmacy, so we do not give vaccines in person. Your prescriber or a local pharmacy can handle those.
We fill human medications only. A veterinary pharmacy would be the right place for a pet prescription.

questions: do you sell over the counter
entries.answer: Over-the-counter items and vitamins are available on Amazon, and many can be added into PillPack packets alongside your prescriptions.
If anything you have received is recalled, we contact you directly by phone and email with what to do. A representative can check whether anything on your account is affected.

questions: do you carry something not on the list
I did not find my medication
you do not have my drug
entries.answer: We carry a very wide range, so let me look it up rather than assume. If it turns out we cannot fill it, a pharmacist can suggest what to ask your prescriber.

questions: can I pick it up in store
do you have a physical pharmacy
is there a store I can go to
do you have a pharmacy counter
entries.answer: We're a mail-order pharmacy, so there's no counter to collect from. Everything ships to you, free two-day delivery on every order, and same-day at eligible addresses.

Dispensed prescriptions can't be returned once they've left us, which is a federal rule rather than our policy. If something arrived wrong, damaged, or you didn't order it, we replace it at no cost and a pharmacist can help sort it out.

questions: why do my pills look different this time
this is a different colour than last time
entries.answer: That usually means the generic came from a different manufacturer this time. The medication and the strength are the same. If anything looks off to you, a pharmacist can check the specific fill against your prescription.

questions: do you ship to my state
can you ship out of state
entries.answer: We ship to most addresses across the United States. If yours turns out not to be covered, a pharmacy representative can tell you right away and go through the options with you.

questions: how do I know it's the real thing
is it safe to order from you
entries.answer: We're a licensed pharmacy and everything is dispensed and sealed by us before it ships. Your medication comes with the usual pharmacy labelling and paperwork, and a pharmacist is available if you have questions about a specific fill.
